text: The text exhibits strong cohesion within its main body, effectively using transitional devices to link ideas. The phrase "On top of your main task" serves as a directive header, separating the instruction from the content. The core paragraph flows logically: "Moreover" adds supporting detail to the initial claim about climate change, and "Therefore" introduces a logical consequence based on the previous statements. The final sentence uses "These efforts" as a cohesive device to refer back to the investments in renewable energy, summarizing the outcome. However, the inclusion of the unrelated question about the color of an eggplant at the very beginning disrupts the thematic cohesion of the paragraph that follows, creating a disjointed start before the coherent argument begins.
